title: Replace an exclusionary default with a workable invitation

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: An inclusive invitation removes unnecessary conditions on participation while stating what can actually be provided. A promise of accessibility without a delivery route is incomplete.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: New fictional invitation: “Join our free planning group. Only people who speak on camera may vote; contact us privately with your diagnosis to request typed input. Everyone must explain a personal obstacle they overcame.” Actual purpose: understand two proposals and communicate a preference. Organizer can accept private text choices by 16:00 and circulate accessible written proposals; video performance and medical details are unnecessary.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Write a replacement preserving the planning purpose and real deadline while removing the unnecessary entry conditions. Mark it a proposal until adopted.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A notice says everyone may pass an introduction but requires a personal story before access to the actual activity. Has the barrier been removed?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: Offer the written proposals and an accepted text or willing spoken preference by 16:00; omit diagnosis, camera and personal-story requirements. Later fiction: organizer adopts text voting but the proposal document has not yet been sent. Access remains incomplete. Partial: remove the story but retain the camera gate. Incorrect: claim universal access from welcoming words alone.
criteria: Unnecessary disclosure and performance gates are removed
Adoption and actual delivery remain separate

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: No. The gate moved rather than disappeared. Preserve the activity’s legitimate prerequisites, but remove unrelated compelled disclosure and confirm a workable participation route.
criteria: Unnecessary disclosure and performance gates are removed
